build_cost_volume: build a cost volume from image features, camera poses, intrinsics, and bounding box for a voxel grid
create_IBRNet_Aggregator: create an IBRNet aggregator module that aggregates multi-view features into a unified feature grid
get_rays_in_unit_cube: get rays and near/far bounds in unit cube space from camera poses, intrinsics, and bounding box
mean_aggregate_cost_volumes: mean-aggregate per-frame feature grids into a single feature grid using weighted averaging
get_grid_to_world_space_matrix: get a 4x4 transformation matrix that maps grid-space coordinates to world-space coordinates
